act.name: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Act, 2006
act.source_authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of India
act.description: Central law promoting MSMEs and governing delayed payments and Facilitation Council remedies for micro and small enterprises.

sections.title: Liability of buyer to make payment.
sections.text: Section 15 concerns the buyer's time-bound payment obligation to a micro or small enterprise supplier; consult the linked official text for the complete provision.
sections.plain_language_summary: A buyer must pay an eligible micro or small enterprise within the statutory or agreed period.
